Issue: Vercel preview is public and indexable
Evidence: owd-dev.vercel.app serves every page with no noindex, no canonical, no robots.txt, and no password. A full duplicate of production is open to Google.
Fix: Turn on Vercel Deployment Protection for preview domains, or add an X-Robots-Tag: noindex header scoped to *.vercel.app hosts in vercel.json. Do this today.

Issue: Phone number conflicts with confirmed NAP
Evidence: Build uses 833-695-1214 on all 58 pages (48 tel: links). Confirmed NAP is 844-931-4624. Live WP header shows 844, body and footer show 833.
Fix: Pick one number for the NAP and use it everywhere: site, schema, GBP, citations. If 833 is a call-tracking line, keep it only in click-to-call buttons and put 844 in the footer address block and schema.

Issue: No structured data on any page
Evidence: 0 of 58 pages have JSON-LD. Production gets Organization, WebSite, and BreadcrumbList from RankMath today. Content standards also require Article + FAQPage on every post.
Fix: Add sitewide Organization (ProfessionalService) + WebSite. Add BreadcrumbList on every inner page. Add Article with Ryan Kearney as author on all 18 posts. Add FAQPage where an FAQ exists. Add Service on the 10 service pages. Starter block below.

Issue: No canonical tags, no Open Graph, no Twitter cards
Evidence: 0 of 58 pages. Shares on Facebook, LinkedIn, and Slack will show no image or a random one.
Fix: Self-referencing canonical on every page, always pointing at https://outworkemdigital.com/... (never the vercel.app host). og:title, og:description, og:image, og:url, twitter:card on every page.

Issue: No analytics or pixels
Evidence: No GA4, no GTM, no Meta pixel on any page. Production fires Meta pixel 908509337671469 today.
Fix: Add GTM container sitewide, with GA4 and Meta pixel inside it. Verify pageviews and form submits fire on the GHL booking iframe at /schedule/ before launch.

Issue: Indexed URLs with no destination
Evidence: 9 URLs Google knows are not in the build (listed in docs/url-map.md). Live nav and footer also link to 9 more URLs that do not exist in the new structure. No vercel.json exists, so no redirects are configured.
Fix: Full list with destinations is in the 301 Redirect Map tab of the workbook. Rebuild the Forbes and Reddit/ChatGPT news posts rather than redirecting. Those are trust and AI search assets. Verify against the GSC Pages report before launch.

Issue: 138 images hotlinked to WordPress
Evidence: 21 blog and academy pages load images from outworkemdigital.com/wp-content/uploads. The moment WordPress comes down, every one breaks.
Fix: Download those files into /img, convert to WebP, and repoint the src paths.

Issue: Feedback widget loads on every page
Evidence: Feedbucket script (feedbucket.app) is injected in the head of all pages.
Fix: Remove before production. Keep it on preview only.

Issue: No robots.txt, sitemap.xml, or 404 page
Evidence: None exist. Footer shows "Sitemap" as plain text with no link.
Fix: Add robots.txt with sitemap reference, a sitemap.xml of all 58 URLs, and a branded 404.html with links to services and the discovery call. Resubmit sitemap in GSC on launch day.

Issue: Non-site files are publicly served
Evidence: Repo root is deployed as-is: wireframe-dark.html, web-design-page.pdf (11 MB), inspiration/, markdown copy drafts, a "stdout" file, and docs/domain-spoofing-runbook.html are all reachable URLs.
Fix: Move working files out of the deploy root or exclude them. The domain-spoofing runbook especially should not be public.

Issue: Homepage lost its primary keyword
Evidence: Live title: "Home Services Digital Marketing Agency | Outwork'em Digital". Live H1 includes "Digital Marketing Agency". New title drops "Digital", new H1 is "The Agency Built for Home Service Contractors".
Fix: Check GSC queries for the homepage first. If "digital marketing agency" terms drive impressions, restore them to the title and H1. The SOP rule: preserve title, H1, and meta on money pages through a redesign.

Issue: Titles over 60 characters
Evidence: 36 of 58 pages. Blog posts run 80 to 113 characters. Example: "8 Proven Strategies to Dominate Google Map Pack Rankings for HVAC & Home Service Contractors | Outwork'em Digital".
Fix: Service pages in the 61 to 69 range are fine if the keywords earn it. Rewrite the 18 blog and 11 news titles to about 60 so the keyword is not cut off. Drop the brand suffix on long post titles if needed.

Issue: Broken meta description
Evidence: /hvac-marketing/search-engine-optimization/guide-to-seo-for-hvac-contractors/ has "There is blood on the streets." (30 characters). 34 other pages run over 160 characters.
Fix: Rewrite that one now. Trim the rest to about 155 when touching each page.

Issue: Missing alt text
Evidence: 123 images across 20 pages have no alt, all on blog and academy pages.
Fix: Descriptive alt with the topic keyword where it fits naturally.

Issue: Broken internal links
Evidence: 5 internal targets 404 in the build: /marketing-services/hvac-ppc-advertising-services/, /marketing-services/hvac-reputation-management-services/, /hvac-marketing-programs/, /2025-plan/, /2025-worksheet/.
Fix: Repoint to current URLs. Details in the Broken Links tab.

Issue: Old brand remnants
Evidence: Slug /news/jana-kearney-joins-top-seer-marketers-full-time-as-creative-director/. Anchor IDs like #top-seer-marketers-local-seo-services-for-hvac in 5 posts.
Fix: Rename the anchor IDs now (zero risk). For the news slug, rename to jana-kearney-joins-outworkem-digital-... with a 301 and update the title to the current brand.

Issue: Layout shift risk
Evidence: Only 75 of 600 images have width and height set. 277 are lazy-loaded.
Fix: Add width and height to every img. Lazy-load everything below the fold, never the hero.

Issue: Inline CSS repeated on every page
Evidence: 40 to 62 KB of CSS inlined in every HTML file. Nothing caches between page views.
Fix: Move shared CSS to one external stylesheet. Keep only critical above-the-fold CSS inline.

Issue: Icon font is heavy
Evidence: Full Material Symbols variable font loads render-blocking on 59 pages.
Fix: Subset with the icon_names parameter to the roughly 30 icons in use, or swap to inline SVG.

Issue: Repo and image weight
Evidence: img/ is 204 MB. 202 of 221 files are not referenced by any page. Meet the Team loads a 1.7 MB JPG.
Fix: Remove unused originals from the deployed folder. Convert used photos to WebP at display size.

Issue: No call to action in the homepage hero
Evidence: The hero has an H1, subhead, and dashboard image with zero links or buttons. On mobile, the first CTA a visitor sees is below the fold. Live WP hero has Book Discovery Call plus a phone number.
Fix: Add a primary "Book Your Discovery Call" button and a secondary click-to-call directly under the subhead. Repeat the pattern on every service page hero.

Issue: No phone number in the header
Evidence: Header shows only "Let's Talk". Service pages have zero tel: links in the body. Home service owners call. Live WP shows the number in the header.
Fix: Add a click-to-call number in the desktop header and a sticky call/book bar on mobile.

Issue: Pricing page shows prices without enough proof next to them
Evidence: /marketing-programs/ lists $2,500/mo and $3,500/mo tiers. Price anchoring works best with a case study result and testimonial right beside each tier.
Fix: Put one result stat and one client quote under each tier. Add a "Not sure which fits? Book a call" line under the grid.

Issue: Homepage lost its trust signals
Evidence: Live homepage has an 8-logo client strip, Google / Semrush / BrightLocal / Forbes badges, and two named client testimonials. The new homepage has none of these.
Fix: Bring back the client logo strip under the hero, the partner and press badges, and at least two named testimonials with photos. Add a Google review count and star rating if GBP supports it.

Issue: Most service pages have no testimonial
Evidence: Organic SEO, Local SEO, PPC, LSA, and Reputation pages have FAQs but no client quote.
Fix: One relevant testimonial plus a link to the matching case study on each service page.

Issue: Case studies have no date or author, and 3 of 5 have no client quote
Evidence: Comfort One and Janecek have quotes. Desert State, Integrity, and Pool Boys do not. None show a publish date.
Fix: Add date, a client quote, the client's name and role, and a before/after metric block. Dated proof reads as current proof to AI engines.

Issue: No author entity for Ryan Kearney
Evidence: Posts show the byline as text only. There is no author page and no link from the byline.
Fix: Create /about-us/ryan-kearney/ (or an anchor on Meet the Team) with a bio, headshot, credentials, and sameAs links (LinkedIn, podcast). Link every byline to it. Add Person schema and reference it as Article author.

Issue: No dedicated vertical pages
Evidence: /who-we-serve/ lists 13 trades as H2s on one page, about 480 words total. There are no HVAC, plumbing, roofing, or electrician landing pages.
Fix: This is the biggest ranking gap on the site. Build vertical pages starting with HVAC, plumbing, roofing, and electrical, then link each H2 on /who-we-serve/ to them. Month 2 link outreach depends on these existing.

Issue: Reading level far above the 6th to 7th grade target
Evidence: Service pages score grade 14 to 17. Several blog posts score 17 to 22 (Flesch-Kincaid). Homepage is grade 10.
Fix: Shorten sentences and swap jargon on the 10 service pages first. They convert. Then the highest-traffic posts.

Issue: FAQ blocks missing on most posts
Evidence: Only 7 of 18 posts have an FAQ section. The content standard is an FAQ with FAQPage schema on every post.
Fix: Add 4 to 6 FAQs to the other 11 posts, written as the questions people type into ChatGPT and Google.

Issue: Thin pages
Evidence: News posts run 150 to 240 words. /our-work/ has about 130 words. Academy index pages about 100 words.
Fix: Our Work: add a short results line and link under each project. News: add a quote, a result, and a link to the related case study, or noindex the weakest ones. Academy: add an intro paragraph targeting "home service marketing" terms.

Issue: Stale year references in titles
Evidence: "2024 Ultimate Guide", "2025 Digital Marketing Planning Workshop", "2025 Website Formula", "2024 SEO Formula Replay". It is now late 2026.
Fix: Refresh content and update the year in titles, H1s, and meta. Keep the URLs as they are, since changing slugs costs more than it gains.

Issue: Icon names leak into menu and link text
Evidence: Material Symbols uses ligatures, so the raw HTML reads "trending_up All Case Studies", "hvac HVAC Contractor Case Study", "dark_mode light_mode". That is what crawlers and AI engines see as anchor text. If the font is slow, visitors see it too.
Fix: Add aria-hidden="true" to every icon span, and ideally swap to inline SVG icons. Fixes anchor text, accessibility, and the render-blocking font in one move.

Issue: No local proof on the page
Evidence: Address appears only in the footer. No map embed, no GBP link, no hours, no "Phoenix" signal outside the footer.
Fix: Add an About/contact block with the full NAP, a GBP link, and a map embed on /about-us/ and /schedule/. Make it match the schema exactly.

Issue: Missing basic landmarks
Evidence: No <main> element and no skip-to-content link on any page. Dropdown menus have no aria-expanded state.
Fix: Wrap page content in <main>, add a skip link, and toggle aria-expanded on the three dropdowns and the mobile menu.

Issue: Homepage scrolls sideways on mobile
Evidence: At 390px wide, the homepage is 10px wider than the screen. Other key pages are fine.
Fix: Find the overflowing element on the homepage and set max-width: 100% or overflow-x: hidden on its section.

Issue: Content hidden until scroll
Evidence: Sections use a .reveal class that sets opacity to 0 until an IntersectionObserver fires. In a full-page render, most of the homepage below the first section is blank. low indexing risk, but if JS fails the page looks empty.
Fix: Default content to visible and add the animation only after JS adds a class to <html>. Respect prefers-reduced-motion.

Issue: Small tap targets and no favicon
Evidence: 20 links or buttons on the mobile homepage are under 24px. No favicon link on any page, so tabs and Google mobile results show a blank icon.
Fix: Minimum 44px tap area on nav, footer, and social icons. Add favicon.ico, a 180px apple-touch-icon, and a 512px PNG.

Evidence: Live on outworkemdigital.com today (WordPress)
Fix: Repoint each card to its own service page
